data.title: Development Manager, Satellite Technologies
data.summary: Develops satellite-based services, business and solutions for critical communications. Evaluates emerging technologies, leads pilots and projects, and works with national and international partners.

requirements.text: Knowledge of satellite technologies and satellite-based services

requirements.question: What does 'business development expertise' look like in this job? One concrete example helps us find people who have done it.
requirements.why: The posting asks for business development expertise without describing a concrete example.

requirements.text: Product development or technology development expertise
Experience leading projects or development programmes
Ability to work in research, development and innovation projects
requirements.question: What does 'ability to work in research, development and innovation projects' look like in this job? One concrete example helps us find people who have done it.
requirements.why: The posting asks for readiness to work in research, development and innovation projects.

requirements.text: Ability to assess technologies technically and commercially
Good collaboration, communication and networking skills
requirements.question: What does 'good collaboration, communication and networking skills' look like in this job? One concrete example helps us find people who have done it.
requirements.why: The posting requests strong interpersonal skills without giving a concrete workplace example.

requirements.text: Fluent English for an international working environment
requirements.question: Is English needed from day one, or could someone start in Finnish and build up English on the job?
requirements.why: Fluent English is requested for work in an international environment.

requirements.text: Knowledge of satellite communications, Earth observation or GNSS
Knowledge of 3GPP NTN and satellite-mobile network integration
